Name: Buildings Included
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
With the new 1.6 update we got a new farm type which comes with a pre-built coop and two little chicks.
However, this is currently not possible without adding a building with C#... Until now!

This mod allows modders to add buildings to be instantly placed on a map through a custom asset which can be edited through content patcher or C#.

[b][size=5]For Players:[/size][/b]
[size=2]This mod does nothing on its own, if you're not here because another mod depends on it, you most likely won't need it.
[/size]
[b][size=5]For Mod Authors:
[/size][/b]To get started as quick as possible, documentation is provided on the [url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/MapBuildings#Buildings-Included]github page.

[/url][b][size=4]How to install : [/size][/b]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder

[url=https://github.com/MindMeltMax/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/main/MapBuildings][Source Code][/url]
